purpose: Define an independent MeritCore history per identity, preventing merit histories from being merged across separately created identities.

value.identity_rule: MeritCore timeline belongs to one exact IAM/IdentityCore identity reference.
value.isolation_rule: Merit histories from separate identities cannot be merged or combined.
value.reset_rule: Creating a new identity starts a new independent MeritCore history and does not transfer prior merits.
value.history_rule: Merit evidence/history remains traceable over time.
value.project_rule: Evidence references exact Project identities rather than free-form CV claims.
value.ownership_rule: MeritCore owns merit-history semantics but not the underlying Project identity.
value.presentation_rule: A CV-like projection may be derived from MeritCore history without becoming the source record.
